questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: One of my really close relations is from Italy, and I have been with her there, different places several times, so Rome was an obvious attraction to me, to deepen my understanding of the culture there. Also the fact of Romes importance in the world history and as birthplace for one of the EU treaties, 1957, as an political science student, was crucial to me.
